description: Use when building a polished or professional-looking Excel report with openpyxl (borders, number formats, header/freeze-pane styling — not general visual design like logos or custom fonts); when an openpyxl read of a large or complex .xlsm investment-banking or financial model chokes, hangs, or silently mangles data during extraction (not for repairing broken formula logic inside the model); or when scrolling to a cell, zooming, or selecting a range in the Excel window on macOS via AppleScript/osascript (not general Excel scripting or plain data entry on Mac). Covers a decision test for when raw zipfile+XML parsing is needed instead of openpyxl for pathological .xlsm files, and a timeout-safe AppleScript/osascript invocation pattern so window-control calls cannot hang indefinitely if Excel is not responding. The window-control piece is macOS-only.
